scheme_name: Scheme For Grant Of Rewards To The Children Of Salt Labourers
other_conditions: Child must be of a salt worker who has completed at least one year of continuous service in any salt work
Child must be studying in Class VI to XII in a recognized Government School
Child must have passed the examination in the first attempt
Preference will be given to SC/ST/BC/Backward area applicants over general category applicants
At least 50% of the awards in each state must be allocated to girl children
benefits_summary: Cash rewards of ₹1000 for classes VI‑VIII, ₹1500 for IX‑X and ₹2000 for XI‑XII are given to meritorious children of salt workers each academic year.
documents_required: Certificate from the salt worker’s employer confirming one year of continuous service
Certificate confirming the child passed the examination in the first attempt
Certified copy of the child’s mark sheet issued by the concerned board
